package composeconfig

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// CreateComposeConfigInput holds create data.
type CreateComposeConfigInput struct {
	Title       string
	Description string
	Config      []byte
	TechIDs     []int
	Status      int
}

// CreateComposeConfig creates compose config with optional tech links.
type CreateComposeConfig struct {
	ComposeConfigs     repository.ComposeConfigRepository
	ComposeConfigTechs repository.ComposeConfigTechRepository
	Tx                 repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle creates compose config.
func (uc CreateComposeConfig) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateComposeConfigInput) (domain.ComposeConfig, error) {
	var cfg domain.ComposeConfig
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		title := strings.TrimSpace(in.Title)
		description := strings.TrimSpace(in.Description)
		if title == "" || description == "" {
			derivedTitle, derivedDescription := domain.DeriveComposeConfigMeta(in.Config)
			if title == "" {
				title = derivedTitle
			}
			if description == "" {
				description = derivedDescription
			}
		}
		cfg = domain.ComposeConfig{
			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
			Title:       &title,
			Description: &description,
			Config:      in.Config,
			Status:      in.Status,
			CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
		}
		if err := uc.ComposeConfigs.Create(ctx, cfg); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if uc.ComposeConfigTechs != nil && len(in.TechIDs) > 0 {
			if err := uc.ComposeConfigTechs.Replace(ctx, cfg.ID, in.TechIDs); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return domain.ComposeConfig{}, err
	}
	return cfg, nil
}
